description.narrative: The Project is expected to increase value addition and lead to job creation in the NARTD market in Angola. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will contribute to increasing competitiveness of the market by introducing improved business practices through demonstration, replication, and competition.

The proposed investment is a senior debt facility comprised of a 30 million long-term loan and a 10 million short-term loan to Nuvibev SGPS, S.A. (Nuvibev or the Group) and its key subsidiaries namely Refriango Indústria e Comércio Geral, Lda. (Refriango), Luanday Comércio e Serviços, Lda. (Luanday), and Wayfield - Trading Internacional S.A. (Wayfield) (Refriango, Luanday and Wayfield together the Companies). The investment will assist in sustaining employment and consumer goods production and contribute to drinking water security in Angola (the Project).
